title: Amna Suraka & Drive to Erbil
full_text:
Visit Amna Suraka, or the red museum, which documents some of the atrocities that were committed during the past regime’s time.
Afterwards, head to Erbil.
Visiting the Citadel of Erbil (Currently closed, only to be viewed from the outside)
Touring the Citadel’s buzzling market in Erbil.
Visiting Jalil Khayat Mosque.
Transfer to Erbil int. Airport.
